result.explanation:
Output fields:
- summary_stats: Statistical overview of found ORFs
  * total_orfs: Total number of ORFs found
  * forward_orfs: Number of ORFs on forward strand
  * reverse_orfs: Number of ORFs on reverse strand
  * avg_length: Average length of all ORFs in base pairs
- orfs: List of all found ORFs, where each ORF contains:
  * sequence: Nucleotide sequence of the ORF
  * aa_sequence: Translated amino acid sequence
  * start: Start position in original sequence (0-based)
  * end: End position in original sequence
  * strand: '+' for forward strand, '-' for reverse complement
  * frame: Reading frame (1,2,3 for forward; -1,-2,-3 for reverse)

Output fields:
- summary_stats: Statistical overview of found ORFs
  * total_orfs: Total number of ORFs found
  * forward_orfs: Number of ORFs on forward strand
  * reverse_orfs: Number of ORFs on reverse strand
  * avg_length: Average length of all ORFs in base pairs
- orfs: List of all found ORFs, where each ORF contains:
  * sequence: Nucleotide sequence of the ORF
  * aa_sequence: Translated amino acid sequence
  * start: Start position in original sequence (0-based)
  * end: End position in original sequence
  * strand: '+' for forward strand, '-' for reverse complement
  * frame: Reading frame (1,2,3 for forward; -1,-2,-3 for reverse)

input_length_nt.population: entire supplied input; nominal DNA symbols even if its alphabet is incompatible
input_length_nt.missing_behavior: null when required operands or saved cells are unavailable/incompatible; independent observed counts survive

reported_row_count.population: all supplied native rows, including malformed rows and repeated occurrences
reported_row_count.missing_behavior: null when required operands or saved cells are unavailable/incompatible; independent observed counts survive

usable_saved_row_count.population: saved rows agreeing with their retained operands; corrupt/missing saved rows excluded
usable_saved_row_count.missing_behavior: zero means no usable saved rows; it does not establish zero native ORFs

forward_row_count.population: usable saved rows with the literal supplied forward strand
forward_row_count.missing_behavior: null when required operands or saved cells are unavailable/incompatible; independent observed counts survive

reverse_row_count.population: usable saved rows with the literal supplied reverse strand
reverse_row_count.missing_behavior: null when required operands or saved cells are unavailable/incompatible; independent observed counts survive

strand_known_row_count.population: usable saved rows; unknown strands do not count as forward or reverse
strand_known_row_count.missing_behavior: null when required operands or saved cells are unavailable/incompatible; independent observed counts survive

retained_length_sum_nt.population: usable saved rows having a nucleotide string, including incompatible source definitions or translations
retained_length_sum_nt.missing_behavior: null without a native row list or an intact reported-row-count cell; an empty available-string population sums to zero with denominator zero

retained_length_denominator_rows.population: same exact string-length population; excludes unavailable strings and corrupt/missing saved rows
retained_length_denominator_rows.missing_behavior: zero means no available strings in the usable saved population, not a measured zero ORF length

mean_retained_orf_length_nt.population: same exact retained string-length population; not a complete-enumeration mean unless separately evidenced
mean_retained_orf_length_nt.missing_behavior: null for zero denominator or unavailable numerator; preserve the actual partial/corrupt-row denominator separately

source_definition_compatible_row_count.population: usable saved rows passing literal input/interval/frame/start/stop/request consistency checks; not confidence
source_definition_compatible_row_count.missing_behavior: null when required operands or saved cells are unavailable/incompatible; independent observed counts survive

translation_compatible_row_count.population: usable saved rows consistent with supplied observed settings and frozen codon reference; not confidence
translation_compatible_row_count.missing_behavior: null when required operands or saved cells are unavailable/incompatible; independent observed counts survive

interval_length_nt.population: one native row's bounded geometric interval; separate from actual nucleotide-string length
interval_length_nt.missing_behavior: null when required operands or saved cells are unavailable/incompatible; independent observed counts survive

nucleotide_symbol_count.population: one actual retained string, even when source-definition or translation compatibility fails
nucleotide_symbol_count.missing_behavior: null when required operands or saved cells are unavailable/incompatible; independent observed counts survive

protein_symbol_count.population: all literal returned symbols; no inferred or replacement protein
protein_symbol_count.missing_behavior: null when required operands or saved cells are unavailable/incompatible; independent observed counts survive

termination_codon_index.calculation: first reference-supported stop after fully known preceding codons
termination_codon_index.population: the retained oriented ORF nucleotide string under observed Standard/to_stop settings
termination_codon_index.missing_behavior: null when required operands or saved cells are unavailable/incompatible; independent observed counts survive

untranslated_suffix_nt.population: retained nucleotide suffix after the omitted translation stop; excludes that stop
untranslated_suffix_nt.missing_behavior: null when required operands or saved cells are unavailable/incompatible; independent observed counts survive

omitted_stop_codon_count.population: the identified stop is omitted by to_stop=True; no CDS validation is asserted
omitted_stop_codon_count.missing_behavior: null when required operands or saved cells are unavailable/incompatible; independent observed counts survive

native_summary_comparisons.calculation: native_value - retained_population_value; signed, with no rescaling
native_summary_comparisons.population: total_orfs uses retained native row count; strand comparisons require every saved row usable and every strand known; avg_length comparison additionally requires every actual nucleotide-string length. No difference certifies complete enumeration
native_summary_comparisons.missing_behavior: null difference when either operand is unavailable; native values remain separate. avg_length compares native one-decimal rounding, including its empty-list zero convention; the calculated empty-population mean remains null

definitions.combinations: only the explicit string-length mean and signed native-summary differences; no score or annotation probability

components.mean_definition: sum actual retained nucleotide-string lengths / rows with those strings; no-ORF mean is null; native empty-population zero is retained separately
components.meaning: literal ATG-to-next-literal-stop ORF measurements; not gene prediction, coding validation or annotation confidence
